_about: Curated CORDIS DET queries for Marie Sklodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) call subjects, keyed by the subject the tagger looks up (Call.topic_title where present, else the call title / Call.name). Subjects auto-extracted verbatim from the work-programme JSON, queries AI-authored + adversarially verified in the contenttype=project phrase-quoted style of cluster_1.json/cluster_3.json. CORDIS indexes EU RESEARCH projects (FP1-Horizon Europe); for non-research calls (and broad funding instruments such as ERC/MSCA) these find thematically related research, so a call's tags are the research fields of related funded projects, NOT its official scope. Re-run POST /cordis/tag-calls {"source":"msca"} to apply.

queries.MSCA COFUND 2026: contenttype=project AND ("Marie Sklodowska-Curie" OR "Marie Curie" OR "MSCA") AND ("COFUND" OR "co-funded fellowship" OR "fellowship programme") AND ("researcher mobility" OR "doctoral training" OR "career development")
